Vodafone AMG-Mercedes: Run by HWA from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. Bernd Schneider won the 2000 and 2001 titles. Car #4 is entered as Express-Service AMG-Mercedes.
AMG-Mercedes: The second HWA car pair from Affalterbach. Marcel Fässler and Jean Alesi drive the 2003 CLK.
PlayStation 2 Red Bull Abt-Audi: The second Abt Sportsline car pair from Kempten. Mattias Ekström is in his third DTM season.
Hasseröder Abt-Audi: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run the Abt-Audi TT-R since 2000. Laurent Aïello won the 2002 title with the team.
OPC Team Phoenix: Ernst Moser's team from Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Runs the 2003 Astra V8 Coupé for Opel.
OPC Team Holzer: One of three Opel teams. Runs the 2003 Astra V8 Coupé for Manuel Reuter and Alain Menu.
Service 24h AMG-Mercedes: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Runs year-old 2002 CLKs.
OPC Euroteam: The third Opel team. Runs year-old 2002 Astras.
S line Audi Junior Team: Abt's third team, backed by Audi. Two young drivers race year-old 2002 TT-Rs.
Original-Teile AMG-Mercedes: Ingmar Persson's team. Runs three year-old 2002 CLKs. Car #20 is entered as ARTA AMG-Mercedes.
